§6Silicon§f

§aThe backbone of every circuit from here to endgame. No silicon, no progress.§f

Silicon is a semiconducting element vital for creating advanced circuit boards. You need an §bElectric Arc Furnace§f to produce it.

Yields from the Arc Furnace: §bSand§f gives 1 nugget, §bNether Quartz§f gives 3, §bFlint§f gives 4 + quanta, §bAsbestos§f gives 4 + quanta, §bFiberglass§f gives 4 + quanta.

Processing chain: Silicon Boule gets stamped with a §bCircuit Stamp§f to make a §bPrinted Silicon Wafer§f. That wafer + Insulator + Copper Wire = §bMicrochip§f. Microchip + Printed Wafer + Bismuth + Copper Wire = §bVersatile Integrated Circuit§f.

§ePS:§f Use §bliquid mode§f on the Arc Furnace (red button) for a small yield bonus. Set up a Strand Caster under the outlet for automated billet casting.
